Genpact LTD, also listed as GENPACT LTD, is a for-profit public company headquartered in Hamilton, D0, with ticker G and CIK number 0001398659. The website associated with the company is generali.com, which presents the corporate website of Assicurazioni Generali Group. The site describes content including storytelling on topics of general interest, information about activities, financial data, news, CSR, career opportunities, and history. It also describes a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence" intended to enhance excellence across customer relationships, the Group operating model, and core capabilities.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for Genpact LTD in the available data.
